headline: Georgian Court end Felician's unbeaten run against conference sides
dek: No conference side had beaten Felician until Georgian Court won there on the last day of October. Every other Felician defeat came against a non-conference opponent, and their season now stands at six wins, eight draws and five losses.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Goals have not decided the table: Bridgeport have scored 44 and conceded 37, in a season of eight wins, three draws and seven defeats.

wire.line: Wilmington top the table despite draws with Felician, Holy Family and Dominican and a defeat by Jefferson.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gijs van Eif has scored nine goals for Georgian Court from 71 shots, and has eight assists.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mathias Kristoffersen has kept nine shutouts for Felician and conceded twelve goals all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Goldey-Beacom have conceded 58 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, in a season of one win, three draws and fourteen defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dane Bodziak has scored eight goals for Chestnut Hill from eighteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bruno Mestres has made 103 saves for Holy Family and conceded 25 goals.

last_match.line: The sides' earlier meeting, at Georgian Court, ended goalless; Georgian Court have won at Dominican and at Felician since losing at Jefferson.

next_match.line: Wilmington won the sides' earlier meeting, at Bridgeport; Bridgeport come from a win at Holy Family, who had beaten them there in October.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
